repo.description:
### Impact

A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the video placeholder component. An authenticated user at the default trust level can post crafted HTML that injects an attacker-controlled event handler into a viewer’s session. When a viewer opens the post and clicks the play overlay on the video placeholder, the injected handler executes arbitrary JavaScript.

Default Discourse installations are protected by Content Security Policy (CSP) which blocks inline event handlers. However, instances with CSP disabled or relaxed (operator-toggleable settings) are fully exploitable, allowing the attacker to act as the viewer in the application, read page content, and make authenticated requests on their behalf.

### Workarounds

No known workarounds for this issue.
repo.summary: Stored XSS via video placeholder attribute breakout
